title: Fix launcher paths after layout migration
summary: Repair promoted-layout launcher, setup, health, local API startup, and PowerShell entrypoint path resolution so the desktop/API surface and pipeline validate against the current ops/pipeline and src layout.
reason: The operator tool was no longer starting the pipeline because launchers and entrypoints still resolved removed or legacy locations after the layout migration, including nested ops/pipeline paths, entrypoints/Tools tool paths, missing PYTHONPATH for the packaged subtitle helper, and repo-only config health checks that ignored the active per-user config.
behavior_before: Dev launchers and desktop launchers could resolve the wrong repository root or Python host; MediaPipeline.ps1 looked for FFmpeg, MKVToolNix, Python, and ass_to_srt.py under old locations; setup/audit/rerun helpers used stale tool/config roots; local API startup progress warned about missing entrypoints/Tools binaries even when current bundled tools existed.
behavior_after: Canonical launchers resolve the promoted apps/desktop, src, and ops/pipeline layout; MediaPipeline.ps1 validates using ops/pipeline/tools, ops/pipeline/runtime/Python, and src/mediapipeline/pipeline/ass_to_srt_cli.py; setup and verifier diagnostics respect the active per-user config and AllowSystemTools policy; local API startup progress reports the current bundled tool paths.
manual_validation: Local API launcher bootstrap smoke - passed: emitted desktop_local_api_bootstrap.v1, /api/health responded, startup tool checks complete for ops/pipeline/tools paths, /api/backend/shutdown returned ok and wrapper exited 0
PowerShell parse checks for touched PS1 files - passed

ops/scripts/dev/start-local-api.bat --port 8765 --token <redacted> --emit-startup-progress - passed; /api/health responded, /api/launch/preflight returned desktop_launch_preflight.v1, /api/pipeline/start mode=validate spawned PID 23832, /api/backend/shutdown returned ok, wrapper exited 0

ops/scripts/dev/verify-env.bat - passed after installing psutil 7.2.2 into the ignored bundled desktop Python runtime; layout, tools, packages, active per-user config, setup validator, OCR paths, and standalone network mode were OK

pwsh -File ops/pipeline/entrypoints/MediaPipeline.ps1 -EmitQueuePlan -QueuePlanOutPath LocalBase/tmp/codex-proof-queue-plan.json -ConfigPath %LOCALAPPDATA%/MediaPipelineRemuxEncodeAIO/MediaPipeline_config.psd1 - passed; wrote queue_plan_snapshot.v1 with 63 runnable rows and exited before processing

pwsh -File ops/pipeline/entrypoints/MediaPipeline.ps1 -ValidateOnly -ConfigPath %LOCALAPPDATA%/MediaPipelineRemuxEncodeAIO/MediaPipeline_config.psd1 - passed; startup validation completed and exited before scan loop

pwsh -File ops/pipeline/tests/Invoke-EndToEndSmokeChecks.ps1 - passed; generated temporary media, ran queue-plan, deferred-publish processing, drain, output codec checks, CSV rerun dry-run, and CPU fallback encode smoke
rollback_plan: Revert the touched launcher, setup, local API startup, and PowerShell path-resolution edits in this packet, then rerun the same validate-only and local API bootstrap checks to confirm the previous behavior is restored. Do not change operator config or media files during rollback.
notes:
Fixed promoted-layout launcher, entrypoint, setup, health, end-to-end smoke, and local API startup path resolution so pipeline startup uses ops/pipeline tools, active per-user config, bundled Python, and packaged subtitle helper.
Proof on 2026-06-04 covered bundled health, direct validate-only startup, Local API pipeline.start validate launch, live queue-plan dry-run against current config, and generated-media end-to-end processing/drain/codec/fallback smoke. Full processing against the operator's live 63-row queue was not run.
